theorem F_all {x : ℕ} (hx : x.Prime) (h5 : 5 ≤ x) :
    ∏ p ∈ (Icc 1 x).filter Nat.Prime, ((p : ℝ) / (p - 1)) <
      Real.exp Real.eulerMascheroniConstant * Real.log (thetaN x) +
        2.50637 / Real.log (thetaN x) := by
  rcases le_or_gt x (10 ^ 5) with h | h
  · exact MertProd.mertens_product_kernel x hx h5 h
  rcases lt_or_ge x (10 ^ 12) with h' | h'
  · exact F_mid (by omega) h'
  · exact F_large h'

proof_context.conclusion: RS62 Thm 15 in product form for primes x>=5: prod_{p<=x} p/(p-1) < e^gamma log theta(x) + 2.50637/log theta(x).

  have hprodF : ∏ i ∈ range k, ((Nat.nth Nat.Prime i : ℝ) / (Nat.nth Nat.Prime i - 1)) =

theorem bigF_gt {r : ℝ} (hr : 3 ≤ r) :
    3.75 < Real.exp Real.eulerMascheroniConstant * Real.log (Real.log r) +
      2.50637 / Real.log (Real.log r) := by
  have hl1 : 1 < Real.log r := by
    rw [Real.lt_log_iff_exp_lt (by linarith)]
    exact Real.exp_one_lt_d9.trans_le (by linarith)
  set t := Real.log (Real.log r)
  have ht : 0 < t := Real.log_pos hl1
  have hG := exp_gamma_ge
  have h1 : 1.625 * t ≤ Real.exp Real.eulerMascheroniConstant * t :=
    mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hG ht.le
  have h2 : 3.75 < 1.625 * t + 2.50637 / t := by
    rw [← sub_pos]
    have e : 1.625 * t + 2.50637 / t - 3.75 = (1.625 * t ^ 2 - 3.75 * t + 2.50637) / t := by
      field_simp; ring
    rw [e]; apply div_pos _ ht
    nlinarith [sq_nonneg (t - 1.15385)]
  linarith

proof_context.conclusion: For r >= 3, 3.75 < e^gamma log log r + 2.50637/log log r, using e^gamma >= 1.625.

theorem hfun_antitone {z₁ z₂ : ℝ} (h9 : rexp 9 ≤ z₁) (h12 : z₁ ≤ z₂) : hfun z₂ ≤ hfun z₁ := by
  have hz₁ : 0 < z₁ := lt_of_lt_of_le (Real.exp_pos 9) h9
  have hz₂ : 0 < z₂ := by linarith
  have hs₁ : 9 ≤ Real.log z₁ := by rw [Real.le_log_iff_exp_le hz₁]; exact h9
  have hs12 := Real.log_le_log hz₁ h12
  have hrp : ∀ z : ℝ, 0 < z → ∀ p : ℝ, z ^ p = rexp (p * Real.log z) := fun z hz p => by
    rw [Real.rpow_def_of_pos hz, mul_comm]
  -- first term
  have hA := antitoneOn_mul_exp_neg (Q := fun s => s ^ (3 / 2 : ℝ))
    (Q' := fun s => 3 / 2 * s ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ)) (s₁ := 9) (s₂ := Real.log z₂) (p := 1 / 6)
    (fun s hs => by
      have := Real.hasDerivAt_rpow_const (x := s) (p := 3 / 2) (Or.inl (by linarith [hs.1]))
      convert this using 2; norm_num)
    (fun s hs => by
      have hs0 : 0 < s := by linarith [hs.1]
      have e : s ^ (3 / 2 : ℝ) = s * s ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ) := by
        rw [← Real.rpow_one_add' hs0.le (by norm_num)]; norm_num
      rw [e]
      have : 0 ≤ s ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ) := by positivity
      nlinarith [hs.1])
  have hB := antitoneOn_mul_exp_neg (Q := fun s => s) (Q' := fun _ => 1) (s₁ := 9)
    (s₂ := Real.log z₂) (p := 1 / 3) (fun s _ => hasDerivAt_id s) (fun s hs => by
      linarith [hs.1])
  have m1 : Real.log z₁ ∈ Icc 9 (Real.log z₂) := ⟨hs₁, hs12⟩
  have m2 : Real.log z₂ ∈ Icc 9 (Real.log z₂) := ⟨hs₁.trans hs12, le_rfl⟩
  have h1 := hA m1 m2 hs12
  have h2 := hB m1 m2 hs12
  simp only at h1 h2
  unfold hfun
  rw [hrp z₁ hz₁, hrp z₂ hz₂, hrp z₁ hz₁ (-1 / 3), hrp z₂ hz₂ (-1 / 3)]
  have e1 : ∀ s : ℝ, rexp (-1 / 6 * s) = rexp (-(1 / 6) * s) := fun s => by ring_nf
  have e2 : ∀ s : ℝ, rexp (-1 / 3 * s) = rexp (-(1 / 3) * s) := fun s => by ring_nf
  rw [e1, e1, e2, e2]
  nlinarith

theorem gx_scale_le_of_one_le {y n w : ℝ} (hy : 0 < y) (hw : 1 ≤ w)
    (hn : 670 ≤ n) (hny : n ≤ y ^ (1 / 3 : ℝ) / 6) :
    gx (w * y) n ≤ gx y n := by
  have hw0 : 0 < w := by linarith
  have hY : 0 < y ^ (1 / 3 : ℝ) := by positivity
  have hYw : y ^ (1 / 3 : ℝ) ≤ (w * y) ^ (1 / 3 : ℝ) :=
    Real.rpow_le_rpow hy.le (by nlinarith) (by norm_num)
  have hR : R (w * y) (2 * n) ≤ R y (2 * n) := by
    refine R_le_R (by linarith) le_rfl ?_ ?_
    · rw [one_lt_div (by positivity)]; nlinarith
    · exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (by linarith) (by positivity)
  have hR0 : 0 ≤ R (w * y) (2 * n) := R_nonneg (by linarith) (by linarith)
  have hl0 : 0 ≤ Real.log (2 * n) := Real.log_nonneg (by linarith)
  have hF0 := Fr_pos hn
  have hA : (R (w * y) (2 * n) * Real.log (2 * n) + 0.8764) * √(Fr n) ≤
      (R y (2 * n) * Real.log (2 * n) + 0.8764) * √(Fr n) :=
    mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (by nlinarith) (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)
  have hC : (w * y) ^ (-1 / 6 : ℝ) ≤ y ^ (-1 / 6 : ℝ) :=
    Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_nonpos hy (by nlinarith) (by norm_num)
  unfold gx
  have := div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (show (R (w * y) (2 * n) * Real.log (2 * n) + 0.8764) * √(Fr n) + 2.526 ≤
    (R y (2 * n) * Real.log (2 * n) + 0.8764) * √(Fr n) + 2.526 by linarith) (Real.sqrt_nonneg (2 * n))
  have := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hC (show (0:ℝ) ≤ 3.8 by norm_num)
  linarith

proof_context.conclusion: For w >= 1 and 670 <= n <= y^{1/3}/6, g_{wy}(n) <= g_y(n): x |-> g_x(n) is non-increasing (Lean's gx).

theorem S_etaStar_eq {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 < x) (α : ℝ) :
    S etaStar x α = ∫ w in Ioi (0:ℝ), S eta2 (w * (x / κ)) α * ((phi w / w : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
  have hκ : (0 : ℝ) < κ := by rw [κ]; norm_num
  set y := x / κ with hy_def
  have hy : 0 < y := div_pos hx hκ
  set F : ℕ → ℝ → ℂ := fun n w =>
    ((Λ n * eta2 (n / (w * y)) * (phi w / w) : ℝ) : ℂ) * TernaryGoldbach.e (n * α) with hF
  have hphiw : ∀ w, 0 < w → phi w / w = w * Real.exp (-(1 / 2) * w ^ 2) := by
    intro w hw
    unfold phi
    field_simp
  -- `η_*(n/x)` as a `w`-integral
  have hstar : ∀ n : ℕ, etaStar (n / x) = ∫ w in Ioi (0:ℝ), eta2 (n / (w * y)) * (phi w / w) := by
    intro n
    rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos n with rfl | hn
    · simp only [Nat.cast_zero, zero_div]
      unfold etaStar mellinConv
      simp only [mul_zero, zero_div]
      refine setIntegral_congr_fun measurableSet_Ioi fun w _ => ?_
      have h1 : phi 0 = 0 := by simp [phi]
      have h2 : eta2 0 = 0 := by simp [eta2]
      simp [h1, h2]
    · unfold etaStar
      rw [mellinConv_eq_swap _ _ (by positivity)]
      refine setIntegral_congr_fun measurableSet_Ioi fun w (hw : 0 < w) => ?_
      rw [mul_div_assoc]
      congr 2
      rw [hy_def]
      field_simp
  have hstar0 : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 ≤ etaStar (n / x) := by
    intro n
    rw [hstar n]
    refine setIntegral_nonneg measurableSet_Ioi fun w (hw : 0 < w) => ?_
    have : 0 ≤ phi w := by unfold phi; positivity
    exact mul_nonneg (eta2_nonneg _) (div_nonneg this hw.le)
  -- measurability and domination
  have hmeas : ∀ n : ℕ, Measurable fun w : ℝ => eta2 (n / (w * y)) * (phi w / w) := by
    intro n
    have hphi : Continuous phi := by unfold phi; fun_prop
    exact (continuous_eta2.measurable.comp (measurable_const.div (measurable_id.mul_const y))).mul
      (hphi.measurable.div measurable_id)
  have hgauss : IntegrableOn (fun w : ℝ => w * Real.exp (-(1 / 2) * w ^ 2)) (Ioi 0) :=
    (integrable_mul_exp_neg_mul_sq (b := 1 / 2) (by norm_num)).integrableOn
  have hint_real : ∀ n : ℕ,

    intro n
    refine Integrable.mono' (hgauss.const_mul 3) (hmeas n).aestronglyMeasurable ?_
    refine (ae_restrict_iff' measurableSet_Ioi).2 (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun w (hw : 0 < w) => ?_)
    rw [hphiw w hw, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg (eta2_nonneg _),
      abs_of_nonneg (by positivity)]
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (eta2_le _) (by positivity)
  have hFint : ∀ n, Integrable (F n) (volume.restrict (Ioi 0)) := by
    intro n
    have : Integrable (fun w : ℝ => ((Λ n * (eta2 (n / (w * y)) * (phi w / w)) : ℝ) : ℂ))
        (volume.restrict (Ioi 0)) := ((hint_real n).const_mul (Λ n)).ofReal
    refine (this.mul_const (TernaryGoldbach.e (n * α))).congr (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun w => ?_)
    simp only [F, mul_assoc]
  have hFn : ∀ n, ∫ w in Ioi (0:ℝ), F n w =
      ((Λ n * etaStar (n / x) : ℝ) : ℂ) * TernaryGoldbach.e (n * α) := by
    intro n
    simp only [F]
    rw [integral_mul_const, integral_complex_ofReal, hstar n, ← integral_const_mul]
    congr 3
    funext w
    ring
  have hFnorm : ∀ n, ∫ w in Ioi (0:ℝ), ‖F n w‖ = ‖((Λ n * etaStar (n / x) : ℝ) : ℂ)‖ := by
    intro n
    rw [Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs,
      abs_of_nonneg (mul_nonneg ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt_nonneg (hstar0 n)), hstar n,
      ← integral_const_mul]
    refine setIntegral_congr_fun measurableSet_Ioi fun w (hw : 0 < w) => ?_
    have : 0 ≤ phi w := by unfold phi; positivity
    simp only [F, norm_mul, norm_e, mul_one, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs]
    rw [abs_of_nonneg ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt_nonneg, abs_of_nonneg (eta2_nonneg _),

  simp only [F]
  rw [← tsum_mul_right]
  refine tsum_congr fun n => ?_

theorem norm_S_etaStar_le {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 < x) (α : ℝ) :
    ‖S etaStar x α‖ ≤ ∫ w in Ioi (0:ℝ), ‖S eta2 (w * (x / κ)) α‖ * (phi w / w) := by
  rw [S_etaStar_eq hx]
  refine (norm_integral_le_integral_norm _).trans (le_of_eq ?_)
  refine setIntegral_congr_fun measurableSet_Ioi fun w (hw : 0 < w) => ?_
  have : 0 ≤ phi w := by unfold phi; positivity
  rw [norm_mul, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (div_nonneg this hw.le)]

/-- The trivial bound `|S_{η₂}(α, z)| ≤ 3 ψ(z) ≤ 17 z`. -/
theorem norm_S_eta2_le_trivial {z : ℝ} (hz : 0 < z) (α : ℝ) : ‖S eta2 z α‖ ≤ 17 * z := by
  unfold S
  have hs : ∀ n ∉ Finset.range (⌊z⌋₊ + 1),
      ((Λ n * eta2 (n / z) : ℝ) : ℂ) * TernaryGoldbach.e (n * α) = 0 := by
    intro n hn
    rw [Finset.mem_range, not_lt, Nat.succ_le_iff, Nat.floor_lt hz.le] at hn
    rw [eta2_eq_zero, mul_zero, Complex.ofReal_zero, zero_mul]
    rintro ⟨-, h1⟩
    rw [div_lt_one hz] at h1
    linarith
  rw [tsum_eq_sum hs]
  refine (norm_sum_le _ _).trans ?_
  have h1 : ∀ n ∈ Finset.range (⌊z⌋₊ + 1),
      ‖((Λ n * eta2 (n / z) : ℝ) : ℂ) * TernaryGoldbach.e (n * α)‖ ≤ 3 * Λ n := by
    intro n _
    rw [norm_mul, TernaryGoldbach.norm_e, mul_one, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs,
      abs_of_nonneg (mul_nonneg ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt_nonneg (eta2_nonneg _))]
    nlinarith [eta2_le (n / z), @ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt_nonneg n]
  refine (Finset.sum_le_sum h1).trans ?_
  rw [← Finset.mul_sum]
  have hpsi : ∑ n ∈ Finset.range (⌊z⌋₊ + 1), Λ n = Chebyshev.psi z := by
    have e : Finset.range (⌊z⌋₊ + 1) = insert 0 (Finset.Ioc 0 ⌊z⌋₊) := by
      ext n; simp only [Finset.mem_range, Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_Ioc]; omega
    rw [e, Finset.sum_insert (by simp), ArithmeticFunction.map_zero, zero_add]
    rfl
  rw [hpsi]
  have h4 : Real.log 4 < 1.3863 := by
    rw [show (4 : ℝ) = 2 ^ 2 by norm_num, Real.log_pow]
    have := Real.log_two_lt_d9; push_cast; linarith
  have := Chebyshev.psi_le_const_mul_self hz.le
  nlinarith

    (hG1 : min 1 w * n ≤ (w * y) ^ (1 / 3 : ℝ) / 6 → gx (w * y) (min 1 w * n) ≤ G)
    (hG2 : 0.276 * (w * y) ^ (5 / 6 : ℝ) * Real.log (w * y) ^ (3 / 2 : ℝ) +
      1234 * (w * y) ^ (2 / 3 : ℝ) * Real.log (w * y) ≤ G * (w * y)) :
    ‖S eta2 (w * y) α‖ ≤ G * (w * y) := by
  set z := w * y with hz_def
  have hz0 : 0 < z := by linarith
  obtain ⟨hTz, -, hTz23, -⟩ := cube_root_facts hz
  have hQ1 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ 3 / 4 * z ^ (2 / 3 : ℝ) := by rw [hTz23]; nlinarith
  obtain ⟨δ, a, q, h⟩ := exists_approx2 α hz0 hQ1
  have hy' : Approx2 α y (δ / w) a q (3 / 4 * z ^ (2 / 3 : ℝ)) := by
    obtain ⟨h1, h2, ⟨k, hk⟩, h4, h5⟩ := h
    have e : δ / w / y = δ / z := by rw [hz_def]; field_simp
    exact ⟨h1, h2, ⟨k, by rw [e]; exact hk⟩, by rw [e]; exact h4, h5⟩

    calc min 1 w * n ≤ min 1 w * (max 1 (|δ| / w / 8) * q) :=

      _ = min 1 w * max 1 (|δ| / w / 8) * q := by ring
      _ ≤ max 1 (|δ| / 8) * q := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hmm hq0
  rcases le_or_gt (q : ℝ) (z ^ (1 / 3 : ℝ) / 6) with hq | hq

  · exact ((theorem_3_1_1 hz h).2 hq).trans hG2

/-- **The weight of a character of conductor `c`**:
`Σ_{q ≥ 1, q̃ ≤ X} [c ∣ q] w(q, c)/φ(q) = (c/φ(c)) κ_c G_{c̃}(X/c̃)`. -/
theorem weight_sum (c : ℕ) (hc : 1 ≤ c) (X : ℝ) :
    ∑ q ∈ (Icc 1 ⌊X⌋₊).filter (fun q => (qt q : ℝ) ≤ X),
        (if c ∣ q then TernaryGoldbach.wq q c else 0) / q.totient =
      c / c.totient * (kap c * Gq (qt c) (X / qt c)) := by
  rw [weight_sum_r c hc X]
  congr 1
  unfold Gq
  rcases Nat.even_or_odd c with hce | hco
  · -- even conductor
    have hqt : ∀ r, qt (c * r) = c * r := fun r => by
      unfold qt; rw [if_pos (hce.mul_right r)]
    rw [kap, if_pos hce, one_mul, show qt c = c by unfold qt; rw [if_pos hce]]
    refine sum_congr ?_ fun _ _ => rfl
    ext r
    simp only [mem_filter, mem_Icc, hqt]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨⟨hr1, -⟩, hrX, hcop⟩
      exact ⟨⟨hr1, (le_floor_div_iff hr1 hc X).2 hrX⟩, hcop⟩
    · rintro ⟨⟨hr1, hrX⟩, hcop⟩
      have h := (le_floor_div_iff hr1 hc X).1 hrX
      refine ⟨⟨hr1, Nat.le_floor (le_trans ?_ h)⟩, h, hcop⟩
      exact_mod_cast Nat.le_mul_of_pos_left r hc
  · -- odd conductor: odd and even `r` contribute equally
    have hc2 : ¬ Even c := Nat.not_even_iff_odd.2 hco
    rw [kap, if_neg hc2, show qt c = 2 * c by unfold qt; rw [if_neg hc2]]
    set A := (Icc 1 ⌊X⌋₊).filter (fun r => (qt (c * r) : ℝ) ≤ X ∧ Nat.Coprime r c)
    set B := (Icc 1 ⌊X / ((2 * c : ℕ) : ℝ)⌋₊).filter (fun r => Nat.Coprime r (2 * c))
    rw [← sum_filter_add_sum_filter_not A (fun r => Odd r), two_mul]
    congr 1
    · -- odd `r`
      refine sum_congr ?_ fun _ _ => rfl
      ext r
      simp only [A, B, mem_filter, mem_Icc, Nat.coprime_mul_iff_right, Nat.coprime_two_right]
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨⟨⟨hr1, -⟩, hrX, hcop⟩, hodd⟩
        have hq : qt (c * r) = 2 * c * r := by
          unfold qt; rw [if_neg (Nat.not_even_iff_odd.2 (hco.mul hodd))]; ring
        rw [hq] at hrX
        exact ⟨⟨hr1, (le_floor_div_iff hr1 (by omega) X).2 hrX⟩, hodd, hcop⟩
      · rintro ⟨⟨hr1, hrX⟩, hodd, hcop⟩
        have hq : qt (c * r) = 2 * c * r := by
          unfold qt; rw [if_neg (Nat.not_even_iff_odd.2 (hco.mul hodd))]; ring
        have h := (le_floor_div_iff hr1 (by omega) X).1 hrX
        refine ⟨⟨⟨hr1, Nat.le_floor (le_trans ?_ h)⟩, by rw [hq]; exact h, hcop⟩, hodd⟩
        exact_mod_cast Nat.le_mul_of_pos_left r (by omega)
    · -- even `r = 2r'`
      have hB : ∑ r ∈ B, (μ r : ℝ) ^ 2 / r.totient =
          ∑ r' ∈ (Icc 1 ⌊X / ((2 * c : ℕ) : ℝ)⌋₊).filter (fun r => Nat.Coprime r c),
            ((μ (2 * r') : ℝ)) ^ 2 / (2 * r').totient := by
        simp_rw [moebius_sq_div_totient_two_mul]
        rw [← sum_filter, filter_filter]
        refine sum_congr ?_ fun _ _ => rfl
        ext r
        simp only [B, mem_filter, Nat.coprime_mul_iff_right]
        tauto
      rw [hB]
      refine Finset.sum_nbij' (fun r => r / 2) (fun r' => 2 * r') ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
      · intro r hr
        simp only [A, mem_filter, mem_Icc, Nat.not_odd_iff_even] at hr ⊢
        obtain ⟨⟨⟨hr1, -⟩, hrX, hcop⟩, hev⟩ := hr
        obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ := hev
        have hk : k + k = 2 * k := by ring
        rw [hk] at hr1 hrX hcop ⊢
        rw [Nat.mul_div_cancel_left _ (by norm_num)]
        have hk1 : 1 ≤ k := by omega
        have hq : qt (c * (2 * k)) = 2 * c * k := by
          unfold qt; rw [if_pos ((even_two_mul k).mul_left c)]; ring
        rw [hq] at hrX
        exact ⟨⟨hk1, (le_floor_div_iff hk1 (by omega) X).2 hrX⟩,
          Nat.Coprime.coprime_mul_left hcop⟩
      · intro r' hr'
        simp only [A, mem_filter, mem_Icc, Nat.not_odd_iff_even] at hr' ⊢
        obtain ⟨⟨hr1, hrX⟩, hcop⟩ := hr'
        have hq : qt (c * (2 * r')) = 2 * c * r' := by
          unfold qt; rw [if_pos ((even_two_mul r').mul_left c)]; ring
        have h := (le_floor_div_iff hr1 (by omega) X).1 hrX
        refine ⟨⟨⟨by omega, Nat.le_floor (le_trans ?_ h)⟩, by rw [hq]; exact h, ?_⟩, even_two_mul r'⟩
        · push_cast; nlinarith [show (1:ℝ) ≤ c by exact_mod_cast hc, show (0:ℝ) ≤ r' by positivity]
        · exact Nat.Coprime.mul_left ((Nat.coprime_two_left).2 hco) hcop
      · intro r hr
        simp only [A, mem_filter, Nat.not_odd_iff_even] at hr
        obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ := hr.2
        omega
      · intro r' _; omega
      · intro r hr
        simp only [A, mem_filter, Nat.not_odd_iff_even] at hr
        obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ := hr.2
        rw [show k + k = 2 * k by ring, Nat.mul_div_cancel_left _ (by norm_num)]

theorem wrad_add_le {δ₀ Q x : ℝ} (hx : 0 < x) (hδ : 0 < δ₀) (hQ : 0 < Q) (hQx : δ₀ * Q ^ 2 ≤ x / 2)
    {q q' : ℕ} (hq : 1 ≤ q) (hq' : 1 ≤ q') (hqQ : (qt q : ℝ) ≤ 2 * Q) (hqQ' : (qt q' : ℝ) ≤ 2 * Q) :
    wrad δ₀ Q x q + wrad δ₀ Q x q' ≤ (if Even q ∧ Even q' then 2 else 1) / (q * q') := by
  have hqr : (0 : ℝ) < q := by exact_mod_cast hq
  have hqr' : (0 : ℝ) < q' := by exact_mod_cast hq'
  -- `δ₀Q/x ≤ 1/(2Q)`
  have hk : δ₀ * Q / x ≤ 1 / (2 * Q) := by
    rw [div_le_div_iff₀ hx (by positivity)]; nlinarith
  have hw : ∀ p : ℕ, 1 ≤ p → wrad δ₀ Q x p ≤ 1 / (2 * Q * qt p) := by
    intro p hp
    have hp2 : (0 : ℝ) < qt p := by have := two_le_qt hp; exact_mod_cast (by omega : 0 < qt p)
    unfold wrad
    rw [show δ₀ * Q / (qt p * x) = δ₀ * Q / x / qt p by field_simp]
    calc δ₀ * Q / x / qt p ≤ 1 / (2 * Q) / qt p := by gcongr
      _ = 1 / (2 * Q * qt p) := by field_simp
  refine (add_le_add (hw q hq) (hw q' hq')).trans ?_
  unfold qt at hqQ hqQ' ⊢
  by_cases he : Even q <;> by_cases he' : Even q' <;> simp only [he, he', if_true, if_false,
    and_self, and_true, and_false] at hqQ hqQ' ⊢ <;> push_cast at hqQ hqQ' ⊢ <;>
    rw [div_add_div _ _ (by positivity) (by positivity), div_le_div_iff₀ (by positivity) (by positivity)] <;>
    nlinarith [mul_pos hqr hqr', mul_pos (mul_pos hqr hqr') hQ]

proof_context.conclusion: From $\delta_0Q^2\le x/2$: $\delta_0Q/x\le 1/(2Q)$, so $w_q+w_{q'}\le D/(qq')$ ($D=2$ if both even, else 1) for $\tilde q,\tilde q'\le 2Q$.

/-- **The arcs at level `Q` are disjoint** (`δ₀Q² ≤ x/2`): if `α − k ∈ J_{q,b}` and

theorem arcs_unique {δ₀ Q x : ℝ} (hx : 0 < x) (hδ : 0 < δ₀) (hQ : 0 < Q) (hQx : δ₀ * Q ^ 2 ≤ x / 2)

    (hb' : b' ∈ Bset q') (h1 : α - k ∈ arc δ₀ Q x q b) (h2 : α - k' ∈ arc δ₀ Q x q' b') :
    q = q' ∧ b = b' ∧ k = k' := by
  obtain ⟨hq1, hqQ⟩ := Finset.mem_filter.1 hq
  obtain ⟨hq1', hqQ'⟩ := Finset.mem_filter.1 hq'
  have hq1 := (Finset.mem_Icc.1 hq1).1
  have hq1' := (Finset.mem_Icc.1 hq1').1
  obtain ⟨hbq, hbc⟩ := Finset.mem_filter.1 hb
  obtain ⟨hbq', hbc'⟩ := Finset.mem_filter.1 hb'
  have hbq := Finset.mem_range.1 hbq
  have hbq' := Finset.mem_range.1 hbq'
  have hqr : (0 : ℝ) < q := by exact_mod_cast hq1
  have hqr' : (0 : ℝ) < q' := by exact_mod_cast hq1'
  set c : ℤ := b + k * q
  set c' : ℤ := b' + k' * q'
  have hc : (c : ℝ) / q = b / q + k := by simp only [c]; push_cast; field_simp
  have hc' : (c' : ℝ) / q' = b' / q' + k' := by simp only [c']; push_cast; field_simp
  have hdist : |(c : ℝ) / q - c' / q'| < wrad δ₀ Q x q + wrad δ₀ Q x q' := by
    obtain ⟨h11, h12⟩ := h1
    obtain ⟨h21, h22⟩ := h2
    rw [hc, hc', abs_sub_lt_iff]; constructor <;> linarith
  have hW := wrad_add_le hx hδ hQ hQx hq1 hq1' hqQ hqQ'
  -- `cq' = c'q`
  have hcross : c * q' = c' * q := by
    by_contra hne
    set N : ℤ := c * q' - c' * q
    have hN : N ≠ 0 := sub_ne_zero.2 hne
    have hexpr : (c : ℝ) / q - c' / q' = N / (q * q') := by
      simp only [N]; push_cast; field_simp
    rw [hexpr, abs_div, abs_of_pos (by positivity : (0:ℝ) < q * q')] at hdist
    have hD : (if Even q ∧ Even q' then (2 : ℝ) else 1) ≤ |(N : ℝ)| := by
      split_ifs with hev
      · have hNe : Even N := by
          have e1 : Even (c * q') := ((Int.even_coe_nat q').2 hev.2).mul_left c
          have e2 : Even (c' * q) := ((Int.even_coe_nat q).2 hev.1).mul_left c'
          exact e1.sub e2
        obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := hNe
        have hm0 : m ≠ 0 := by rintro rfl; simp at hm; exact hN hm
        have : (1 : ℤ) ≤ |m| := Int.one_le_abs hm0
        rw [hm]; push_cast
        rw [show (m : ℝ) + m = 2 * m by ring, abs_mul]
        have : (1 : ℝ) ≤ |(m : ℝ)| := by exact_mod_cast this
        norm_num; linarith
      · exact_mod_cast Int.one_le_abs hN
    have := lt_of_lt_of_le hdist hW
    rw [div_lt_div_iff_of_pos_right (by positivity)] at this
    linarith
  -- coprimality gives `q = q'`
  have hcop : IsCoprime c q := by
    have : IsCoprime (b : ℤ) q := Nat.isCoprime_iff_coprime.2 hbc
    simpa [c] using this.add_mul_right_left k
  have hcop' : IsCoprime c' q' := by
    have : IsCoprime (b' : ℤ) q' := Nat.isCoprime_iff_coprime.2 hbc'
    simpa [c'] using this.add_mul_right_left k'
  have hd1 : (q : ℤ) ∣ q' := by
    have : (q : ℤ) ∣ c * q' := ⟨c', by rw [hcross]; ring⟩
    exact hcop.symm.dvd_of_dvd_mul_left this
  have hd2 : (q' : ℤ) ∣ q := by
    have : (q' : ℤ) ∣ c' * q := ⟨c, by rw [← hcross]; ring⟩
    exact hcop'.symm.dvd_of_dvd_mul_left this
  have hqq : q = q' := by
    have := Int.dvd_antisymm (by positivity) (by positivity) hd1 hd2
    exact_mod_cast this
  subst hqq
  have hcc : c = c' := by
    have hq0 : (q : ℤ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast (by omega : q ≠ 0)
    exact mul_right_cancel₀ hq0 hcross
  -- `b + kq = b' + k'q` with `0 ≤ b, b' < q`
  have hkk : k = k' := by
    have h : ((b : ℤ) - b') = (k' - k) * q := by simp only [c, c'] at hcc; linarith

    have : (1 : ℤ) ≤ |k' - k| := Int.one_le_abs (sub_ne_zero.2 (Ne.symm hne))
    have hlt : |(b : ℤ) - b'| < q := by rw [abs_lt]; constructor <;> omega
    rw [h, abs_mul, abs_of_pos (by exact_mod_cast hq1 : (0:ℤ) < q)] at hlt
    nlinarith
  subst hkk
  refine ⟨rfl, ?_, rfl⟩
  have : (b : ℤ) = b' := by simp only [c, c'] at hcc; linarith
  exact_mod_cast this

proof_context.conclusion: Arcs $J_{q,b}$ at level $Q$ (and their integer translates) are pairwise disjoint: overlapping arcs force $cq'=c'q$, hence $(q,b,k)=(q',b',k')$.

/-- `w_q + w_{q'} < D/(qq')` with `D = 2` if `q, q'` are both even and `D = 1` otherwise, when

theorem wrad_add_le {δ₀ Q x : ℝ} (hx : 0 < x) (hδ : 0 < δ₀) (hQ : 0 < Q) (hQx : δ₀ * Q ^ 2 ≤ x / 2)
    {q q' : ℕ} (hq : 1 ≤ q) (hq' : 1 ≤ q') (hqQ : (qt q : ℝ) ≤ 2 * Q) (hqQ' : (qt q' : ℝ) ≤ 2 * Q) :
    wrad δ₀ Q x q + wrad δ₀ Q x q' ≤ (if Even q ∧ Even q' then 2 else 1) / (q * q') := by
  have hqr : (0 : ℝ) < q := by exact_mod_cast hq
  have hqr' : (0 : ℝ) < q' := by exact_mod_cast hq'
  -- `δ₀Q/x ≤ 1/(2Q)`

    rw [div_le_div_iff₀ hx (by positivity)]; nlinarith
  have hw : ∀ p : ℕ, 1 ≤ p → wrad δ₀ Q x p ≤ 1 / (2 * Q * qt p) := by
    intro p hp
    have hp2 : (0 : ℝ) < qt p := by have := two_le_qt hp; exact_mod_cast (by omega : 0 < qt p)
    unfold wrad
    rw [show δ₀ * Q / (qt p * x) = δ₀ * Q / x / qt p by field_simp]
    calc δ₀ * Q / x / qt p ≤ 1 / (2 * Q) / qt p := by gcongr
      _ = 1 / (2 * Q * qt p) := by field_simp
  refine (add_le_add (hw q hq) (hw q' hq')).trans ?_
  unfold qt at hqQ hqQ' ⊢
  by_cases he : Even q <;> by_cases he' : Even q' <;> simp only [he, he', if_true, if_false,
    and_self, and_true, and_false] at hqQ hqQ' ⊢ <;> push_cast at hqQ hqQ' ⊢ <;>
    rw [div_add_div _ _ (by positivity) (by positivity), div_le_div_iff₀ (by positivity) (by positivity)] <;>
    nlinarith [mul_pos hqr hqr', mul_pos (mul_pos hqr hqr') hQ]

/-- **The arcs at level `Q` are disjoint** (`δ₀Q² ≤ x/2`): if `α − k ∈ J_{q,b}` and

theorem arcs_unique {δ₀ Q x : ℝ} (hx : 0 < x) (hδ : 0 < δ₀) (hQ : 0 < Q) (hQx : δ₀ * Q ^ 2 ≤ x / 2)

    q = q' ∧ b = b' ∧ k = k' := by
  obtain ⟨hq1, hqQ⟩ := Finset.mem_filter.1 hq
  obtain ⟨hq1', hqQ'⟩ := Finset.mem_filter.1 hq'
  have hq1 := (Finset.mem_Icc.1 hq1).1
  have hq1' := (Finset.mem_Icc.1 hq1').1
  obtain ⟨hbq, hbc⟩ := Finset.mem_filter.1 hb
  obtain ⟨hbq', hbc'⟩ := Finset.mem_filter.1 hb'
  have hbq := Finset.mem_range.1 hbq
  have hbq' := Finset.mem_range.1 hbq'
  have hqr : (0 : ℝ) < q := by exact_mod_cast hq1
  have hqr' : (0 : ℝ) < q' := by exact_mod_cast hq1'
  set c : ℤ := b + k * q
  set c' : ℤ := b' + k' * q'
  have hc : (c : ℝ) / q = b / q + k := by simp only [c]; push_cast; field_simp
  have hc' : (c' : ℝ) / q' = b' / q' + k' := by simp only [c']; push_cast; field_simp
  have hdist : |(c : ℝ) / q - c' / q'| < wrad δ₀ Q x q + wrad δ₀ Q x q' := by
    obtain ⟨h11, h12⟩ := h1
    obtain ⟨h21, h22⟩ := h2
    rw [hc, hc', abs_sub_lt_iff]; constructor <;> linarith
  have hW := wrad_add_le hx hδ hQ hQx hq1 hq1' hqQ hqQ'
  -- `cq' = c'q`
  have hcross : c * q' = c' * q := by
    by_contra hne
    set N : ℤ := c * q' - c' * q
    have hN : N ≠ 0 := sub_ne_zero.2 hne
    have hexpr : (c : ℝ) / q - c' / q' = N / (q * q') := by
      simp only [N]; push_cast; field_simp
    rw [hexpr, abs_div, abs_of_pos (by positivity : (0:ℝ) < q * q')] at hdist
    have hD : (if Even q ∧ Even q' then (2 : ℝ) else 1) ≤ |(N : ℝ)| := by
      split_ifs with hev
      · have hNe : Even N := by
          have e1 : Even (c * q') := ((Int.even_coe_nat q').2 hev.2).mul_left c
          have e2 : Even (c' * q) := ((Int.even_coe_nat q).2 hev.1).mul_left c'
          exact e1.sub e2
        obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := hNe
        have hm0 : m ≠ 0 := by rintro rfl; simp at hm; exact hN hm
        have : (1 : ℤ) ≤ |m| := Int.one_le_abs hm0
        rw [hm]; push_cast
        rw [show (m : ℝ) + m = 2 * m by ring, abs_mul]
        have : (1 : ℝ) ≤ |(m : ℝ)| := by exact_mod_cast this
        norm_num; linarith
      · exact_mod_cast Int.one_le_abs hN
    have := lt_of_lt_of_le hdist hW
    rw [div_lt_div_iff_of_pos_right (by positivity)] at this
    linarith
  -- coprimality gives `q = q'`
  have hcop : IsCoprime c q := by
    have : IsCoprime (b : ℤ) q := Nat.isCoprime_iff_coprime.2 hbc
    simpa [c] using this.add_mul_right_left k
  have hcop' : IsCoprime c' q' := by
    have : IsCoprime (b' : ℤ) q' := Nat.isCoprime_iff_coprime.2 hbc'
    simpa [c'] using this.add_mul_right_left k'
  have hd1 : (q : ℤ) ∣ q' := by
    have : (q : ℤ) ∣ c * q' := ⟨c', by rw [hcross]; ring⟩
    exact hcop.symm.dvd_of_dvd_mul_left this
  have hd2 : (q' : ℤ) ∣ q := by
    have : (q' : ℤ) ∣ c' * q := ⟨c, by rw [← hcross]; ring⟩
    exact hcop'.symm.dvd_of_dvd_mul_left this
  have hqq : q = q' := by
    have := Int.dvd_antisymm (by positivity) (by positivity) hd1 hd2
    exact_mod_cast this
  subst hqq
  have hcc : c = c' := by
    have hq0 : (q : ℤ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast (by omega : q ≠ 0)
    exact mul_right_cancel₀ hq0 hcross
  -- `b + kq = b' + k'q` with `0 ≤ b, b' < q`
  have hkk : k = k' := by
    have h : ((b : ℤ) - b') = (k' - k) * q := by simp only [c, c'] at hcc; linarith
    by_contra hne
    have : (1 : ℤ) ≤ |k' - k| := Int.one_le_abs (sub_ne_zero.2 (Ne.symm hne))
    have hlt : |(b : ℤ) - b'| < q := by rw [abs_lt]; constructor <;> omega
    rw [h, abs_mul, abs_of_pos (by exact_mod_cast hq1 : (0:ℤ) < q)] at hlt
    nlinarith
  subst hkk
  refine ⟨rfl, ?_, rfl⟩
  have : (b : ℤ) = b' := by simp only [c, c'] at hcc; linarith
  exact_mod_cast this

      ∑ m ∈ ((Icc 1 ⌊t⌋₊).filter (fun r => Nat.Coprime r 1)).filter Squarefree, gf m := by
    refine (sum_filter_of_ne fun m _ h => ?_).symm
    by_contra hs
    exact h (by simp [gf, ArithmeticFunction.moebius_eq_zero_of_not_squarefree hs])
  rw [hsq]
  set D := ((Icc 1 ⌊t⌋₊).filter (fun r => Nat.Coprime r 1)).filter Squarefree
  -- `m ↦ (gcd(m, P), m / gcd(m, P))`

    · exact Nat.div_pos (Nat.le_of_dvd (by omega) (Nat.gcd_dvd_left m P)) hg

/-- **The reduction to `Φ`**: Prop 12.2.4 with `c₊ = 2` holds at `R = Q₀/sq` if
`Φ(q, ⌊R⌋, max(log q, log(10⁵/(⌊R⌋ + 1)))) ≤ 0`. -/
theorem checkC2_suffices {Q Q₀ : ℝ} (hQ : 20000 * Q₀ ≤ Q) (hQ₀ : 1e5 ≤ Q₀)
    (hρ : Real.log Q₀ ≤ 0.6 * Real.log Q) {q : ℕ} (hq : 1 ≤ q) {s : ℝ} (hs : 1 ≤ s)
    (hR : 1 ≤ Q₀ / (s * q))
    (hC : Phi2 q ⌊Q₀ / (s * q)⌋₊
      (max (Real.log q) (Real.log (1e5 / ((⌊Q₀ / (s * q)⌋₊ : ℝ) + 1)))) ≤ 0) :
    Gq q (Q₀ / (s * q)) ≤ (Real.log Q₀ + 2) / (Real.log Q + cE) * Gq q (Q / (s * q)) := by
  obtain ⟨c, hc1, hc2, hram⟩ := ramare_Gq
  refine star_suffices2 hQ hQ₀ hρ hq hs hc1 hc2 ?_
  have hq0 : (0 : ℝ) < q := by exact_mod_cast hq
  have hsq : 0 < s * q := by positivity
  set R := Q₀ / (s * q)
  set n := ⌊R⌋₊
  have hR0 : 0 < R := by linarith
  have hn1 : 1 ≤ n := Nat.le_floor (by exact_mod_cast hR)
  have hn0 : (0 : ℝ) < n := by exact_mod_cast hn1
  have hnR : (n : ℝ) ≤ R := Nat.floor_le hR0.le
  have hRn : R < (n : ℝ) + 1 := Nat.lt_floor_add_one R
  set K := (q : ℝ) / Nat.totient q
  have hK := qphi_pos hq
  have hKk : K * (Nat.totient q / q) = 1 := by
    have : (0 : ℝ) < Nat.totient q := by exact_mod_cast Nat.totient_pos.2 (by omega)
    simp only [K]; field_simp
  have hf := f1q_pos q
  have he2 := e2_bound hq hQ hs hR hram
  have hGn : Gq q R = Gq q n := by unfold Gq; rw [Nat.floor_natCast]
  have hRn3 : R ^ (-(1 / 3 : ℝ)) ≤ 1 / (n : ℝ) ^ (1 / 3 : ℝ) := by
    rw [Real.rpow_neg hR0.le, ← one_div]
    exact one_div_le_one_div_of_le (by positivity) (Real.rpow_le_rpow hn0.le hnR (by norm_num))
  have hsqR : s * q = Q₀ / R := by simp only [R]; field_simp
  have hmax : max (Real.log q) (Real.log (1e5 / ((n : ℝ) + 1))) ≤ Real.log (s * q) := by
    refine max_le (Real.log_le_log hq0 (by nlinarith)) ?_
    rw [hsqR]
    refine Real.log_le_log (by positivity) ?_
    rw [div_le_div_iff₀ (by positivity) hR0]; nlinarith
  have hlogR : Real.log n ≤ Real.log R := Real.log_le_log hn0 hnR
  unfold Phi2 at hC
  have hmx0 : 0 ≤ max 0 (-(Gq q (Q / (s * q)) -
      (Nat.totient q / q) * (Real.log (Q / (s * q)) + c + Sq q))) := le_max_left _ _
  calc K * ((Gq q R - (Nat.totient q / q) * (Real.log R + c + Sq q)) +
        0.6586 * max 0 (-(Gq q (Q / (s * q)) -
          (Nat.totient q / q) * (Real.log (Q / (s * q)) + c + Sq q))))
      = K * Gq q n - (Real.log R + c + Sq q) + K * (0.6586 * max 0 (-(Gq q (Q / (s * q)) -
          (Nat.totient q / q) * (Real.log (Q / (s * q)) + c + Sq q)))) := by
        rw [hGn, mul_add, mul_sub, ← mul_assoc, hKk, one_mul]
    _ ≤ K * Gq q n - (Real.log n + 1.3325822 + Sq q) +
          K * (0.6586 * (7.284 * 0.03685 * (1 / (n : ℝ) ^ (1 / 3 : ℝ)) * f1q q)) := by
        gcongr
        exact he2.trans (by gcongr)
    _ ≤ K * Gq q n - Real.log n - 1.3325822 - Sq q +
          0.1768 * K * f1q q / (n : ℝ) ^ (1 / 3 : ℝ) := by
        have : 0 ≤ K * f1q q / (n : ℝ) ^ (1 / 3 : ℝ) := by positivity
        rw [mul_one_div]
        have e : K * (0.6586 * (7.284 * 0.03685 / (n : ℝ) ^ (1 / 3 : ℝ) * f1q q)) =
            0.6586 * 7.284 * 0.03685 * (K * f1q q / (n : ℝ) ^ (1 / 3 : ℝ)) := by ring
        have e2 : 0.1768 * K * f1q q / (n : ℝ) ^ (1 / 3 : ℝ) =
            0.1768 * (K * f1q q / (n : ℝ) ^ (1 / 3 : ℝ)) := by ring
        rw [e, e2]; nlinarith
    _ ≤ 0.3414 * (max (Real.log q) (Real.log (1e5 / ((n : ℝ) + 1))) - Sq q) + 0.6674177 := by
        linarith
    _ ≤ 0.3414 * (Real.log (s * q) - Sq q) + 0.6674177 := by gcongr

/-- **[H, Prop. 12.1.2]** (with `δ₀ ≥ 2`, see the module docstring).  Let `aₙ` be supported on
primes `> √x`, in `ℓ¹`; `δ₀ ≥ 2`, `Q₀ ≥ 1`, `δ₀Q₀² ≤ x/2`, `Q = √(x/2δ₀)`.  If
`G_q(2Q₀/sq) ≤ C G_q(2Q/sq)` for every even `q ≤ 2Q₀` and `1 ≤ s ≤ 2Q₀/q`, then
`∫_{𝔐_{δ₀,Q₀}} |S(α)|² dα ≤ C Σ |aₙ|²`. -/
theorem prop_12_1_2 {x δ₀ Q₀ C : ℝ} {a : ℕ → ℂ} (ha : PrimeSupported x a)
    (hδ₀ : 2 ≤ δ₀) (hQ₀ : 1 ≤ Q₀) (hx : δ₀ * Q₀ ^ 2 ≤ x / 2)
    (hC : ∀ q : ℕ, 1 ≤ q → Even q → (q : ℝ) ≤ 2 * Q₀ → ∀ s : ℝ, 1 ≤ s → s ≤ 2 * Q₀ / q →
      Gq q (2 * Q₀ / (s * q)) ≤ C * Gq q (2 * √(x / (2 * δ₀)) / (s * q))) :
    ∫ α in Ioc (0 : ℝ) 1 ∩ majorArcs δ₀ Q₀ x, ‖expTsum a α‖ ^ 2 ≤ C * ∑' n, ‖a n‖ ^ 2 := by
  obtain ⟨hsupp, hsum⟩ := ha
  set Q := √(x / (2 * δ₀)) with hQdef
  have hx0 : 0 < x := by nlinarith
  have hδ0 : 0 < δ₀ := by linarith
  have hQsq : Q ^ 2 = x / (2 * δ₀) := Real.sq_sqrt (by positivity)
  have hQ0 : 0 < Q := Real.sqrt_pos.2 (by positivity)
  have hδQ2 : δ₀ * Q ^ 2 = x / 2 := by rw [hQsq]; field_simp
  have hQ₀Q : Q₀ ≤ Q := by
    rw [hQdef]; apply Real.le_sqrt_of_sq_le
    rw [le_div_iff₀ (by positivity)]; nlinarith
  have hδx : δ₀ ≤ x / 2 := by
    have : δ₀ * 1 ≤ δ₀ * Q₀ ^ 2 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (by nlinarith) hδ0.le
    linarith
  have hδQ : δ₀ * Q ≤ x := by
    have hsq : (δ₀ * Q) ^ 2 ≤ x ^ 2 := by
      rw [mul_pow, hQsq]
      rw [show δ₀ ^ 2 * (x / (2 * δ₀)) = δ₀ * x / 2 by field_simp]
      nlinarith
    nlinarith [mul_pos hδ0 hQ0]
  have h2Q : 2 * Q ≤ √x := by
    apply Real.le_sqrt_of_sq_le
    rw [mul_pow, hQsq]
    rw [show (2 : ℝ) ^ 2 * (x / (2 * δ₀)) = 2 * x / δ₀ by field_simp, div_le_iff₀ hδ0]
    nlinarith
  -- the common modulus
  set L := ∏ q ∈ Finset.Icc 1 ⌊2 * Q⌋₊, q with hL
  have hL0 : L ≠ 0 := Finset.prod_ne_zero_iff.2 fun q hq => by
    have := (Finset.mem_Icc.1 hq).1; omega
  have : NeZero L := ⟨hL0⟩
  have hqL : ∀ R, R ≤ Q → ∀ q ∈ Qset R, q ∣ L := by
    intro R hR q hq
    apply Finset.dvd_prod_of_mem
    obtain ⟨hq1, -⟩ := Finset.mem_filter.1 hq
    obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := Finset.mem_Icc.1 hq1
    exact Finset.mem_Icc.2 ⟨h1, h2.trans (Nat.floor_le_floor (by linarith))⟩
  have hcop : ∀ n, a n ≠ 0 → Nat.Coprime n L := by
    intro n hn
    obtain ⟨hp, hnx⟩ := hsupp n hn
    refine Nat.Coprime.prod_right fun q hq => ?_
    obtain ⟨hq1, hq2⟩ := Finset.mem_Icc.1 hq
    refine (Nat.coprime_or_dvd_of_prime hp q).resolve_right fun hdvd => ?_
    have hle := Nat.le_of_dvd (by omega) hdvd
    have : (q : ℝ) ≤ 2 * Q := le_trans (by exact_mod_cast hq2) (Nat.floor_le (by positivity))
    have : (n : ℝ) ≤ q := by exact_mod_cast hle
    linarith
  -- `C ≥ 0`
  have hC0 : 0 ≤ C := by
    have h := hC 2 (by norm_num) even_two (by push_cast; linarith) 1 le_rfl (by
      rw [le_div_iff₀ (by norm_num)]; push_cast; linarith)
    have e1 : 2 * Q₀ / (1 * ((2 : ℕ) : ℝ)) = Q₀ := by push_cast; ring
    rw [e1] at h
    have hG1 := one_le_Gq_two hQ₀
    have hGQ := Gq_nonneg 2 (2 * Q / (1 * ((2 : ℕ) : ℝ)))
    by_contra hneg; push Not at hneg
    nlinarith
  -- the chain
  set g : ℝ → ℝ := fun α => ‖expTsum a α‖ ^ 2
  have hg : Continuous g := (TernaryGoldbach.continuous_expTsum hsum).norm.pow 2
  have hper : Function.Periodic g 1 := fun α => by simp only [g, expTsum_periodic a α]
  have hg0 : ∀ α, 0 ≤ g α := fun α => by positivity
  have hδQ₀ : δ₀ * Q₀ ≤ x := by nlinarith
  calc ∫ α in Ioc (0 : ℝ) 1 ∩ majorArcs δ₀ Q₀ x, ‖expTsum a α‖ ^ 2
      ≤ ∑ q ∈ Qset Q₀, ∑ b ∈ Bset q, ∫ y in arc δ₀ Q₀ x q b, g y :=
        integral_majorArcs_le hg hper hg0 hx0 (by positivity) hδQ₀
    _ = ∫ β, Farc a δ₀ Q₀ x β := sum_arcs_eq_integral_Farc hsum δ₀ Q₀ x
    _ ≤ ∫ β, C * Farc a δ₀ Q x β :=
        integral_mono (integrable_Farc hsum _ _ _) ((integrable_Farc hsum _ _ _).const_mul C)
          fun β => Farc_le hx0 hQ₀ hQ₀Q hC0 hC (hqL Q₀ hQ₀Q) (hqL Q le_rfl) hsum hcop
    _ = C * ∑ q ∈ Qset Q, ∑ b ∈ Bset q, ∫ y in arc δ₀ Q x q b, g y := by
        rw [integral_const_mul, sum_arcs_eq_integral_Farc hsum δ₀ Q x]
    _ ≤ C * ∫ α in Ioc (0 : ℝ) 1, g α :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (sum_arcs_le_integral hg hper hg0 hx0 hδ0 hQ0 hδQ2.le hδQ) hC0
    _ = C * ∑' n, ‖a n‖ ^ 2 := by rw [TernaryGoldbach.setIntegral_norm_sq_expTsum hsum]

proof_context.conclusion: Prop 12.1.2 for δ₀≥2: arc integral ≤ C Σ|aₙ|² given the G_q quotient bound.

/-- **[H, Prop 12.2.4] with `c₊ = 2`** (for [H]'s `1.36`). -/
theorem prop_12_2_4 {Q Q₀ : ℝ} (hQ : 20000 * Q₀ ≤ Q) (hQ₀ : 1e5 ≤ Q₀)
    (hρ : Real.log Q₀ ≤ 0.6 * Real.log Q) {q : ℕ} (hq : 1 ≤ q) (_hqQ : (q : ℝ) ≤ Q₀) {s : ℝ}
    (hs : 1 ≤ s) (hsQ : s ≤ Q₀ / q) :
    Gq q (Q₀ / (s * q)) ≤ (Real.log Q₀ + 2) / (Real.log Q + cE) * Gq q (Q / (s * q)) := by
  have hq0 : (0 : ℝ) < q := by exact_mod_cast hq
  have hsq : 0 < s * q := by positivity
  have hR : 1 ≤ Q₀ / (s * q) := by
    rw [le_div_iff₀ hsq, one_mul]; rw [le_div_iff₀ hq0] at hsQ; exact hsQ
  have hLQ : 0 < Real.log Q + cE := by
    have : 0 < Real.log Q := Real.log_pos (by linarith)
    unfold cE; linarith
  have hG' := Gq_nonneg_q q (Q / (s * q))
  set R := Q₀ / (s * q) with hRdef
  rcases le_or_gt 22000000000 q with hbig | hsmall
  · -- large `q`: [H]'s argument, with `1.36`
    refine weaken_136 hG' hLQ ?_
    rcases le_or_gt (lamQ q) R with hL | hL
    · exact regionL hQ hQ₀ hρ hq hs hR hL
    have hq' : (22000000000 : ℝ) ≤ q := by exact_mod_cast hbig
    have hlq : 3 ≤ Real.log q := by
      have := log_Q1_ge.trans (Real.log_le_log (by norm_num) hq'); linarith
    exact regionS hQ hQ₀ hρ hq hs hR (by norm_num) hlq (hcc_large hbig) (large_q_hS hbig hR hL)
  · -- `q < 2.2·10¹⁰`: the reduction to `Φ`
    refine checkC2_suffices hQ hQ₀ hρ hq hs hR ?_
    set n := ⌊R⌋₊
    have hn1 : 1 ≤ n := Nat.le_floor (by exact_mod_cast hR)
    rcases le_or_gt n 3 with hn3 | hn4
    · exact Phi2_small hq hsmall hn1 hn3
    · have h := Phi2_reduce hn1 (fun A hA => Phi2_base hA (by omega)) q hq hsmall
      exact (Phi2_anti q n (le_max_left _ _)).trans h

/-- **[H, Cor. 12.2.5, (12.42)]** (with `δ₀ ≥ 2`).  Let `Q₀ ≥ 10⁵`, `δ₀ ≥ 2`,
`(20000 Q₀)² ≤ x/2δ₀`, `Q = √(x/2δ₀)`, `2Q₀ ≤ (2Q)^{0.6}`.  Then
`∫_{𝔐_{δ₀,Q₀}} |S|² ≤ (log 2Q₀ + 2)/(log 2Q + c_E) Σ|aₙ|²`. -/
theorem cor_12_2_5 {x δ₀ Q₀ : ℝ} {a : ℕ → ℂ} (ha : PrimeSupported x a)
    (hQ₀ : 1e5 ≤ Q₀) (hδ₀ : 2 ≤ δ₀) (hx : (20000 * Q₀) ^ 2 ≤ x / (2 * δ₀))
    (hρ : 2 * Q₀ ≤ (2 * √(x / (2 * δ₀))) ^ (0.6 : ℝ)) :
    ∫ α in Ioc (0 : ℝ) 1 ∩ majorArcs δ₀ Q₀ x, ‖expTsum a α‖ ^ 2 ≤
      (Real.log (2 * Q₀) + 2) / (Real.log (2 * √(x / (2 * δ₀))) + cE) * ∑' n, ‖a n‖ ^ 2 := by
  set Q := √(x / (2 * δ₀)) with hQdef
  have hQ0 : 0 ≤ x / (2 * δ₀) := le_trans (by positivity) hx
  have hQ : 20000 * Q₀ ≤ Q := by
    rw [hQdef]; exact Real.le_sqrt_of_sq_le hx
  refine prop_12_1_2 ha hδ₀ (by linarith) ?_ fun q hq _ hq2 s hs hsq => ?_
  · have h1 : Q₀ ^ 2 ≤ x / (2 * δ₀) := le_trans (by nlinarith) hx
    have h2 : δ₀ * Q₀ ^ 2 ≤ δ₀ * (x / (2 * δ₀)) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h1 (by linarith)
    have h3 : δ₀ * (x / (2 * δ₀)) = x / 2 := by field_simp
    linarith
  · have h2Q₀ : (0 : ℝ) < 2 * Q₀ := by linarith
    have hlog : Real.log (2 * Q₀) ≤ 0.6 * Real.log (2 * Q) := by
      have := Real.log_le_log h2Q₀ hρ
      rwa [Real.log_rpow (by nlinarith)] at this
    exact prop_12_2_4 (by linarith) (by linarith) hlog hq hq2 hs hsq

theorem abel_le {f g F : ℕ → ℝ} {a b : ℕ} (hab : a ≤ b)
    (hg : ∀ n, a ≤ n → n < b → g (n + 1) ≤ g n) (hg0 : 0 ≤ g b)
    (hS : ∀ n, a ≤ n → n ≤ b → ∑ m ∈ Icc a n, f m ≤ F n) :
    ∑ n ∈ Icc a b, f n * g n ≤ g a * F a + ∑ n ∈ Ioc a b, g n * (F n - F (n - 1)) := by
  -- stronger statement by induction: the defect `g(k)(F(k) − S(k))` is kept
  have key : ∀ k, a ≤ k → k ≤ b →
      ∑ n ∈ Icc a k, f n * g n ≤ g a * F a + ∑ n ∈ Ioc a k, g n * (F n - F (n - 1)) -
        g k * (F k - ∑ m ∈ Icc a k, f m) := by
    intro k hak hkb
    induction k, hak using Nat.le_induction with
    | base => simp; linarith [mul_comm (f a) (g a)]
    | succ k hak ih =>
      have ih := ih (by omega)
      rw [sum_Icc_succ_top (by omega), sum_Icc_succ_top (by omega), sum_Ioc_succ_top hak,
        Nat.add_sub_cancel]
      have hgk := hg k hak (by omega)
      have hSk := hS k hak (by omega)
      nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hgk (sub_nonneg.2 hSk)]
  have := key b hab le_rfl
  have : 0 ≤ g b * (F b - ∑ m ∈ Icc a b, f m) := mul_nonneg hg0 (sub_nonneg.2 (hS b hab le_rfl))
  linarith

    ∀ k, r₀ ≤ k → k ≤ K → ∫ ω in (M r₀)ᶜ, u ω * v ω ∂μ ≤
      ∑ n ∈ Ico r₀ k, g n * ((∫ ω in M (n + 1), u ω ∂μ) - ∫ ω in M n, u ω ∂μ) +
        ∫ ω in (M k)ᶜ, u ω * v ω ∂μ := by

    intro hkK
    have ih := ih (by omega)

    have hsplit : (M k)ᶜ = (M (k + 1) \ M k) ∪ (M (k + 1))ᶜ := by

      have : ω ∈ M k → ω ∈ M (k + 1) := fun h => hmono (show k ≤ k + 1 by omega) h
      tauto
    have hdisj : Disjoint (M (k + 1) \ M k) (M (k + 1))ᶜ :=
      disjoint_compl_right.mono_left sdiff_subset
    have e1 : ∫ ω in (M k)ᶜ, u ω * v ω ∂μ = (∫ ω in M (k + 1) \ M k, u ω * v ω ∂μ) +

    have e2 : ∫ ω in M (k + 1), u ω ∂μ = (∫ ω in M k, u ω ∂μ) + ∫ ω in M (k + 1) \ M k, u ω ∂μ := by

/-- The trivial bound `|S_{η₂}(α, z)| ≤ 3 ψ(z) ≤ 17 z`. -/
theorem norm_S_eta2_le_trivial {z : ℝ} (hz : 0 < z) (α : ℝ) : ‖S eta2 z α‖ ≤ 17 * z := by
  unfold S
  have hs : ∀ n ∉ Finset.range (⌊z⌋₊ + 1),
      ((Λ n * eta2 (n / z) : ℝ) : ℂ) * TernaryGoldbach.e (n * α) = 0 := by
    intro n hn
    rw [Finset.mem_range, not_lt, Nat.succ_le_iff, Nat.floor_lt hz.le] at hn
    rw [eta2_eq_zero, mul_zero, Complex.ofReal_zero, zero_mul]
    rintro ⟨-, h1⟩
    rw [div_lt_one hz] at h1
    linarith
  rw [tsum_eq_sum hs]
  refine (norm_sum_le _ _).trans ?_
  have h1 : ∀ n ∈ Finset.range (⌊z⌋₊ + 1),
      ‖((Λ n * eta2 (n / z) : ℝ) : ℂ) * TernaryGoldbach.e (n * α)‖ ≤ 3 * Λ n := by
    intro n _
    rw [norm_mul, TernaryGoldbach.norm_e, mul_one, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs,
      abs_of_nonneg (mul_nonneg ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt_nonneg (eta2_nonneg _))]
    nlinarith [eta2_le (n / z), @ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt_nonneg n]
  refine (Finset.sum_le_sum h1).trans ?_
  rw [← Finset.mul_sum]
  have hpsi : ∑ n ∈ Finset.range (⌊z⌋₊ + 1), Λ n = Chebyshev.psi z := by
    have e : Finset.range (⌊z⌋₊ + 1) = insert 0 (Finset.Ioc 0 ⌊z⌋₊) := by
      ext n; simp only [Finset.mem_range, Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_Ioc]; omega
    rw [e, Finset.sum_insert (by simp), ArithmeticFunction.map_zero, zero_add]
    rfl
  rw [hpsi]
  have h4 : Real.log 4 < 1.3863 := by
    rw [show (4 : ℝ) = 2 ^ 2 by norm_num, Real.log_pow]
    have := Real.log_two_lt_d9; push_cast; linarith
  have := Chebyshev.psi_le_const_mul_self hz.le
  nlinarith

proof_context.conclusion: Unconditional bound ‖S_{η₂}(α,z)‖ ≤ 17z via ψ(z) ≤ (log 4+4)z; no explicit formula over zeros.

theorem ladder_prime {i : ℕ} (h1 : 1 ≤ i) (h2 : i ≤ 254638308) :

  exact ⟨p, hp, h3, h4⟩
